name: Sorting-free Pre-integrated Projected Tetrahedra
aliases: Sorting-free approach that controls the fragment rendering by using the opacity value
Sorting-free technique for volume rendering of an irregular volume dataset
definition: A sorting-free volume rendering technique for irregular volume datasets that employs projected tetrahedra with pre-integration. It solves the problem of low image quality in particle-based methods (visible footprints) and the scalability/visibility-sorting requirements of conventional methods by treating volume rendering as a stochastic process where sampling points occur along a viewing ray with probability equal to opacity.
